description: Source verification status for videos, playlists, syllabus documents, notes, and external references.

statuses.label: Needs Review
statuses.description: Source has not been verified yet.

statuses.label: Verified
statuses.description: Source has been checked and accepted for the intended internal use.

statuses.label: Replace Recommended
statuses.description: Current source should likely be replaced with a better or safer source.

statuses.label: Rejected
statuses.description: Source is not acceptable for use.

statuses.label: Unknown
statuses.description: Source status is unknown and must be clarified.

notes: Source verification is owned by Source Research/Ira, not Sia.
